Joshua Van Defends UFC Bantamweight Title Against Alexandre Pantoja

Joshua Van successfully defended his UFC bantamweight title against Alexandre Pantoja at UFC 331. The fight, which took place at Crypto.com Arena, saw Van win, with one report noting he had previously defeated Pantoja in 26 seconds. Following the win, Van made a "startling admission." Other fighters reacted to the bout, with one commenting, "50-45 is crazy."
